claude.rationale: gap_45=1: the customer-facing portfolio (79 strip centers, three malls, a warehouse park — T4) crossed the boundary into UE, but corporate support processes that produce/deliver operations (treasury, HR, IT, tax, financial reporting, SEC compliance, insurance — T5) "remained at Vornado" and were not transferred whole, creating a product-vs-process structural mismatch at closing that UE stated it was "dependent on Vornado to provide." gap_56=0: the portfolio-management team, incumbent Retail employees (~100), and portfolio-management department heads moved together with the operations they run, so the operational team/organization aligned coherently (no process-vs-people mismatch). gap_mitigated=yes: the T4/T5 mismatch was contractually absorbed at closing via a two-year Transition Services Agreement (~$3.4M/yr) plus the Separation and Distribution Agreement allocating the shared substrate.

grok.rationale: gap_45=0 because the customer-facing portfolio (79 strip centers, three malls, warehouse park) crossed together with the incumbent portfolio-management team and VRLP Retail employees who ran those properties; corporate support left behind (treasury, HR, IT, tax, reporting, insurance) is back-office substrate, not the property-level operating processes that produce the product. gap_56=0 because the operational processes that did transfer (Retail employees ~100 and the strip/mall management team under Minutoli/Olson) moved with their people and management at closing; the corporate support processes that remained at Vornado never transferred and were instead bridged by the two-year Transition Services Agreement, so there was no process-without-organization mismatch on transferred T5.

openai.rationale: The shopping-center portfolio crossed to UE, but corporate support processes—including treasury, HR, IT, tax, financial reporting, SEC compliance, and insurance—remained at Vornado, documenting a product-versus-process gap at closing. That gap was contractually absorbed through the approximately two-year Transition Services Agreement under which Vornado would provide those interim services. The Retail employees and incumbent portfolio-management team transferred to UE, while the retained support processes continued to be provided by Vornado under the agreement, so no process-versus-organization mismatch is documented.
